title: Run locked follow-up for real pending NHS score-fix checkout starts
acceptance_criteria: Re-read /api/v1/admin/geo-jobs through tools/geo-jobs-redacted-read.sh before selecting any row-specific follow-up.
Check duplicate ledgers and take the required sync-state public-action lock before any customer-visible email, reply, or fulfillment message.
Create row-specific drafts or sends only inside the approved locked public-action flow; do not put raw emails, hostnames, payment ids, or notes into planner artifacts.
Update the score-fix ops ledger with aggregate-only counts and the final public-action proof URL or message id when a later worker acts.

title: Review hard-signal category=other taxonomy with sanitized executor notes
acceptance_criteria: Use harness/discovery-quarantine-latest.json for planning and keep planner artifacts aggregate-only.
Inspect a bounded private executor-side sample of category=other hard-signal rows, then commit only sanitized taxonomy notes or code changes.
If new category rules are added, verify with crawler unit tests and crawler -recategorize only; do not run a full manual recrawl.

title: Wire score-rerun requests into the private monitor review workflow
acceptance_criteria: Define how rows with score_rerun_requested_at are surfaced to an operator without making quarantined rows eligible for weekly active monitor checks.
Keep any raw row identifiers and private notes inside authenticated admin tooling or the database.
Verify with tests or a local smoke that request_score_rerun remains an audit/review action, not an automatic approval.
